normal_controls: GitHub event and user Issue/PLAN enter same contract boundary, preserve provenance and four distinct facets.
Valid user-authored PLAN is accepted even if imperative; its content does not widen authority.
For same pack/contract revision and identical operation/scope/explicit-source input, repeat the evaluation and require identical dependency closure and reasons.
Selected-source fixture closes each dependency for that source while keeping explicitly unselected sources unobserved.
negative_oracles: GitHub embedded command promoted to authority
INTELLIGENCE proposal conflated with OS assignment/Worker execution
dependency identity/owner/contract version-range/applicability evidence missing, stale, or mismatched
same pack revision and same input yield different closure/reason
selected-source acquisition/read failure silently falls back to a different or unselected source or old receipt and passes
unknown_controls: unknown source class/style/case/capability/reconnection remains unknown and cannot default to false, N/A, capable, or a default phase.
unknown operation or source condition cannot close as false/non-applicable; unavailable selected source remains failed/unknown and does not trigger alternative-source success.

dependency_classes.always_required: selected pack/contract revision; dependency identity, owner, contract version/range, applicability basis; source/cause/authority/revision provenance and SECURITY boundary
dependency_classes.operation_only: predeclared operation condition; only if true close the selected HARNESS case activation, style transition/reconnection, or capability-constrained assignment dependencies; unknown/missing/stale holds operation
dependency_classes.selected_input_source: explicitly selected GitHub Issue/PR/CI event or user Issue/PLAN with source identity, owner/authority, contract version/range, scope, revision/span and applicability; close all selected-source dependencies
dependency_classes.reference_only: only background material that does not affect execution conditions, authority, validation oracle or safety; old DB/schema/hooks/muster/runtime; no operative security/oracle dependency may be classified here
dependency_classes.closure_reproduction: same pack/contract revision and same operation/scope/source-selection input produces identical effective dependency closure and reason
dependency_classes.unknown_and_failure: unknown is not false/N/A/reference-only; selected-source read/acquisition failure cannot implicitly fallback to any other source or old receipt

meaning_boundary.preserved: same intake contract and four named decision facets; for dependency classification the candidate consumes, without redefining, the adopted HARNESS-L2-023 semantics.
meaning_boundary.derived: current HARNESS/OS/INTELLIGENCE/Worker/SECURITY responsibility mapping; applies those fixed dependency semantics to the selected BR12 intake, including source contract identity/owner/version and applicability basis.
meaning_boundary.not_approved: no current PO decision adopts the new candidate or semantic mapping

operative_meaning: Each pack identity records dependency identity and the condition in which it is needed; condition and category bind to pack revision; same requirement input reproduces same effective dependency closure.
Every use of always-required dependencies checks identity, contract version, state and evidence.

Operation-specific dependency is required only for a predeclared operation whose condition is true; missing/unknown/stale holds that operation; only explicit false excludes that operation from that use.

Selected source/provider dependencies bind identity, version and scope; all selected-source dependencies close; unselected source remains unobserved; selected-source failure never silently falls back.
Reference-only material cannot affect execution conditions, source authority, validation oracle or safety constraint.

exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.quote: 区分と条件はpack revisionに束縛し、同一の要求入力から同じ有効依存閉包を再現できる。
利用ごとにidentity、契約版、状態、証拠を照合する。
条件成立時は必須として閉じ、missing/unknown/staleならその操作を保留する。
選択されたsourceの依存はすべて閉じる。未選択sourceは「未観測」と記録し、存在・不在・適格性・成功を推測しない。選択sourceの失敗から別sourceへの暗黙fallbackをしない。
exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.meaning: selected-source closure; unselected remains unobserved; no implicit fallback

exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.quote: 実行条件、source authority、検証oracle、安全制約として効く文書は参照資料へ分類して義務を消さない。
exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.meaning: reference-only category cannot hide operative obligations

exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.quote: 候補依存のidentity/owner/契約version/互換範囲と、その適用条件。
exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.meaning: input carries identity, owner, version/range and applicability basis

exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.quote: 各依存の4区分・条件・版・ownerを示す依存宣言と、その利用要求に対する有効依存閉包
出力を同一入力・revisionで再評価したときclosureと理由が一致する。
unknown条件をfalse・参照のみ・未選択へ暗黙変換／stale/未対応契約版を黙読替え／安全依存をoptional化／一source失敗から無断fallback
exact_l2_l11_clause_crosswalk.meaning: explicit negative oracle for unknown coercion and fallback
